title: Soul Snack #69: What Does My Soul Want?
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen HERE.

A new multisensory consciousness is emerging, and it is fundamentally transforming the human experience. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav invites you to explore the most essential question on your spiritual path: What does my Soul want? Every human life unfolds within a field of choice – between fear and love, violence and compassion, unconscious reaction and conscious response. These choices do more than shape your daily events; they determine the very evolution of your Soul.

Gary Zukav describes the Earth as a school of duality, where every single moment offers an opportunity to make a Responsible Choice. 

Fear-based choices – such as anger, jealousy, exploitation, or deceit – are rooted in the frightened parts of your personality. These choices diminish your awareness and limit your ability to align with your Soul’s intention. While fear can feel familiar and magnetic, choosing love requires absolute commitment, courage, and presence at the exact moment a choice appears.

The creation of Authentic Power occurs at the point of choice. When Emotional Awareness replaces automatic reaction, you gain the power to choose love instead of fear. Each loving choice supports the maturation of the personality and the evolution of the Soul. This is the work of a Universal Human – transforming the experience of fear into love, one choice at a time.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

(00:00) — Why choice is the foundation of spiritual evolution
Gary Zukav explains that nothing stands between a person and a life of joy, fulfillment, and gratitude except their choices—and that the universe never judges those choices.

(01:15) — How conscious choice supports the evolution of the soul
Choosing love over fear not only transforms personal experience, but actively assists the soul’s growth toward greater awareness and freedom.

(02:30) — What is poisonous to the soul
Violence, exploitation, deceit, and brutality diminish the soul’s power and cannot be tolerated by it, even though the soul itself is immortal.

(03:40) — Earth as a school of duality
Life continually presents choices between fear and love, light and dark, unconscious reaction and conscious creation—and every choice matters.

(04:45) — The moment where transformation happens
Gary Zukav describes how intervening consciously at the moment of anger, jealousy, or fear allows creativity to be used as it was meant to be used.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, pause when strong emotions such as anger, resentment, jealousy, or the urge to dominate arise. Instead of reacting automatically, ask yourself: What choice is in front of me right now? Notice whether the impulse comes from fear or love, and consciously choose the response that supports awareness, compassion, and the evolution of your soul.
